question: How can the doctrine of six transmission streams be reconciled with that earlier statement?
premises: The earlier statement affirms a single power.
The tradition also speaks of six transmission streams.
The speaker questions how both can hold together.
inference: The existence of six transmission streams appears difficult to reconcile with the earlier statement of unity.
plain_english: O Brāhmī, O lord, if this is indeed your statement, how can there be six transmission streams?
